name: halt_waits_for_records
description: HALT ends only when every record is done
notes: Records and events are the binding answer; `passes` is the simulator's own count and is advisory. Completion: a record issued in pass p is acknowledged by the sweep of pass p + 1 + delay (delay null: never). A KM_F_RESULT record's result is (a0 + count) mod 2^32. Events are [kind, req, aux, pass].
